summary: Tuesday's close leaned risk-off across the board: 10-year real yields held near 2.6%, keeping pressure on both gold and Treasuries, while the S&P slipped below its 50-day average on sharply weaker breadth (equal-weight down 3.7% vs cap-weight's 1.1%). Bitcoin's 30-day rally lost steam as volume thinned, even with prices still up double digits for the month.
tweet: Elevated real yields and a stalled dollar kept gold and bonds under pressure Tuesday, while equity breadth cracked and bitcoin's rally cooled on thin volume.
